text:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] High 401 rate from Sapphire-prod VPC (auth failures) — paging on-call
alex-sre: acked, looking
rina-sre: i'm on it, joining call in 2
leo-support: customer (eva@Sapphire) reporting app users seeing auth errors ~10:15 UTC, on your radar?
eva-customer: yes, spikes started ~10:12, users hitting login flow, tokens failing. Token exchange returns 401.
alex-sre: gathering logs from gateway, suspect OIDC jwks fetching/rotation. seeing a bunch of `malformed_jwt` and `kid not found` errors
sam-devops: pinging idp endpoint from inside VPC: getting 503 intermittently to /.well-known/jwks.json
alex-sre: can someone run: `curl -v https://idp.sapphire.internal/.well-known/jwks.json` from bastion and paste output?
sam-devops: pasted — intermittent 502 and sometimes truncated payload, looks like upstream nginx returning 502 with truncated body
rina-sre: ok that matches svc metrics: jwks endpoint returning 5xx, causes our token verification to fall back and fail with kid mismatch
leo-support: impact: all requests that validate tokens against remote jwks are failing. Dedicated customers unaffected (their token validators use cached JWKS). Affected: Sapphire-prod only for now.
alex-sre: mitigation plan: 1) enable local JWKS cache fallback for Sapphire VPC to use last-good keys 2) temporarily disable aggressive jwks refresh (set interval to 24h) 3) coordinate with Sapphire idp team to restore endpoint
maria-eng: creating canary config to force cache-serve for the VPC route now
deploy-bot: starting rollout of config patch to sapphire-vpc identity-proxy (canary 1/3)
rina-sre: while rollout in progress, i'm going to increase auth cache TTL and add `kid` tolerant check to accept last-known keys for 2m grace
alex-sre: also adding a short-lived bypass for health-check calls so monitoring doesn't spam the idp; we'll revert after fix
sam-devops: notified Sapphire-idp ops channel: they acknowledged high CPU on idp-auth nodes due to cert rotation job failing -> process restarting. They are restarting pool.
eva-customer: their ops says cert rotation failed due to HSM throttling and they are rolling back rotation and will re-run success path in 15m
leo-support: noted, that aligns. Recalculating customer impact: ~27% of token validations are failing, sessions not renewing, user visible login errors. Priority:P1 customer impact but contained.
alex-sre: mitigation in place: canary config applied 1/3, monitoring for 5m. if stable, continue rollout.
maria-eng: canary ok for 5m, rollout 2/3
deploy-bot: rollout 2/3 complete
rina-sre: after 2/3 we see 401s drop from 27% -> 8% but some spikes persist on certain routes (token exchange path)
alex-sre: rolling last canary 3/3
deploy-bot: rollout 3/3 complete
sam-devops: idp pool restart completed, cert rollback finished, jwks endpoint returning 200 and correct JSON now
alex-sre: seeing steady drop in auth failures to <1% — looks recovered. keeping mitigations for 30m then revert TTL change.
eva-customer: confirming login flows working for customers, thanks team.
leo-support: customer satisfaction: they want a postmortem and to ensure rotation job has proper backoff from HSM.
rina-sre: creating incident record and will open a follow-up runbook item: jwks fetch circuit-breaker + local persistent cache for VPC customers.
maria-eng: adding test to our CI that simulates JWKS endpoint outage and ensures cached-validation path works for prod routes
alex-sre: handoff to oncall night: @rina-sre you'll be primary for the next 2 hours, i'm handing off now. if anything flares, page SRE oncall + alex-sre escalation.
rina-sre: ack handoff. I'll keep watch and coordinate postmortem notes.
deploy-bot: rolling back TTL patch scheduled in 30m unless issues reported
alex-sre: preliminary timeline for postmortem: root cause — failed cert rotation at Sapphire idp due to HSM throttling -> jwks endpoint instability -> token validation failures. Mitigations: local jwks cache + temp TTL increase + idp pool restart.
leo-support: noting customer impact summary for CSM: ~15 minutes of partial outage, ~1% residual errors during ramp.
eva-customer: please include exact time windows and actions, their security team wants confirmation that keys used during rollback were not expired.
alex-sre: will include key validity checks and HSM error logs in postmortem.
rina-sre: creating thread in incidents for postmortem doc and will assign owners for follow-ups (HSM backoff, cached-keys persistence, monitoring alerts).
alex-sre: closing incident channel for active mitigation; leaving thread open for PM/PMM/CX notes. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident resolved — status: mitigated, service: sapphire-vpc, severity: P1 -> monitoring
